data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (Cars tab, pick-up, drop-off, dates, times, Search, sort by Total Price), but it omits the filter step and leaves out drop-off location, filters and sort as explicit parameters, so a browser automation built from it would be slightly underspecified.
